title: Mammalian Calling Cards Quick Start Guide
author: Arnav Moudgil
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.xurfnv6
materials: Make C- and N- terminal fusions of your favorite transcription factor (YFTF) with HyPBase . It is important to include a linker sequence between these genes. We strongly recommend the following amino acid linker sequence: KLGGGAPAVGGGPKAADK. We have tested many and have found this sequence works best. It is often convenient to make these fusion constructs by using In-Fusion (Clontech/Takara) or Gibson (NEB) cloning to drop YFTF into pRM1258/pENTR_myc-hypPBase. We do not have good antibodies to the piggyBac transposase, so we recommend designing your construct so that the chimeric protein is tagged with myc .

steps.title: Validate the constructs
steps.instruction: Verify the plasmid integrity and sequence of the chimeric gene.

substeps.instruction: Perform restriction digest analysis on the plasmid using at least 3 restriction enzymes to check for gross rearrangements.
Perform either Sanger sequencing of the full chimeric gene or Illumina sequencing of the whole plasmid.

steps.title: Move chimeric gene to expression vector
steps.instruction: If using the Gateway strategy, move the chimeric gene from the pENTR vector to an expression vector.

steps.title: Assess piggyBac transposase activity
steps.instruction: Validate YFTF-HyPBase and HyPBase-YFTF fusions by transforming HCT-116 cells with the fusions and the BrokenHeart transposon.

substeps.instruction: Use Lipofectamine 3000 according to manufacturer's instructions to deliver 1 µg total DNA to approximately 200,000 cells per well in a 6-well plate.
Optional: Include a 'lipofection only' negative control to assess viability and toxicity.
Optional: Transfect a GFP expression plasmid in parallel to estimate overall transfection efficiency.

steps.title: Prepare calling card libraries
steps.instruction: Generate calling card libraries from successfully selected cells following the bulk calling card protocol by Arnav Moudgil.

steps.title: Sequence calling card libraries
steps.instruction: Sequence the libraries using an Illumina platform (MiSeq, MiniSeq, HiSeq, or NextSeq).

substeps.instruction: Spike in 50% PhiX genome to account for relatively low sequence complexity.
